title: json-fn shorthand parse test suite
description: Documents the shorthand parser test-suite format consumed from spec/cases/parse.

description.description: A description of the test suite.

mode.description: The default parser mode for cases in this suite. Defaults to expression.

cases.description: The parser cases in this suite.

description.description: A description used as the test name.

source.description: The shorthand source text to parse.

mode.description: Overrides the suite parser mode for this case.

expected.description: The expected canonical JSON result. When omitted from a non-error case, the harness expects null.

error.description: Marks a case that must fail. A string must occur in the error message; any other JSON value only requires an error.
